title_working: In This World, Every Step You Take Is Counted
premise: In a world where everyone gets 1,000 steps a day, a boy with 62 left must climb a 100-step hill to light the lighthouse for his mum's ferry.
world_rule: Everyone gets 1,000 steps a day, shown as a glowing number on the chest. At zero you freeze where you stand (awake, but unable to move) until sunrise. Steps cannot be saved; at sunrise everyone resets to 1,000. Hidden part (planted early, revealed late): when people walk holding hands, only one of their numbers goes down.
logline: A boy who is running out of steps needs the one neighbour who never walks anywhere.

characters.name: Kai
characters.want: light the lighthouse lamp so his mum's night ferry finds the harbour
characters.arc: racing alone > failing > asking for help > walking together

look.clothes: yellow raincoat, navy pants, red boots

characters.name: Mrs. Pell
characters.want: never freeze alone in the dark

characters.name: Keeper Marlo
characters.arc: frozen helper who passes on the key

characters.name: Two small kids
characters.look: small avatars in matching red and blue, holding hands

look.clothes: purple dress, green scarf (echoes her shawl)

locations.name: Town street at dusk
locations.look: Kenney city, dusk/sunset light, people with glowing chest numbers

locations.name: Lighthouse hill in fog
locations.look: existing hill set: winding dirt path, bench halfway, striped lighthouse, sea with a ferry, thick blue-grey fog, night

beats.rule: 1,000 steps a day, zero = freeze till sunrise, no saving
beats.plant: two kids holding hands: only one number moves
beats.conflict: fog horn; mum on the ferry; keeper frozen with the key
escalation: Kai climbs alone; fog costs him 3 wasted steps; 9 left at halfway
Mrs. Pell (900 steps) refuses to take the key up alone - she once froze alone on this hill
Kai drops to 4 with 45 to go; ferry drifts toward rocks
beats.reveal: Kai's plea: unspent steps vanish at sunrise; Pell takes his hand: holding hands, you walk on one number
beats.ending: Steps you keep disappear at sunrise; steps you share bring someone home.

lines.text: Sixty-two steps left. A hill that needs one hundred. What would you do?
lines.say: (nervous)(soft tone) Sixty-two steps left. A hill that needs one hundred. What would you do?
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Close on Kai's chest: a glowing 62. Tilt up past his worried face to a dark lighthouse on a foggy hill.

lines.text: In this world, everyone gets one thousand steps a day.
lines.say: (calm) In this world, everyone gets one thousand steps a day.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Town street at dusk. People walk with glowing numbers on their chests.

lines.text: A glowing number on your chest counts every single one.
lines.say: (calm) A glowing number on your chest counts every single one.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Close on a walker's chest number ticking down with each step: 214, 213, 212.

lines.text: When it hits zero, you freeze. You stay awake, but you can't move. Until sunrise.
lines.say: (worried) When it hits zero, (break) you freeze. You stay awake, but you can't move. Until sunrise.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: A man mid-stride hits 0. He locks in place, pale blue, frost sparkles; only his eyes move.

lines.text: And you can't save them. At sunrise, everyone goes back to one thousand.
lines.say: (calm) And you can't save them. At sunrise, everyone goes back to one thousand.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Sunrise light sweeps the street; every number flips to 1000; the frozen man walks on.

lines.text: That evening, I saw two little kids holding hands. Only one of their numbers was going down.
lines.say: (curious) That evening, I saw two little kids holding hands. Only one of their numbers was going down.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: PLANT: two small kids walk holding hands. One number ticks down; the other stays still. Kai glances at them.

lines.text: I had spent all day running to the harbour, watching for my mum's boat.
lines.say: (worried) I had spent all day running to the harbour, watching for my mum's boat.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Kai at the harbour wall, looking out at the sea; his number reads 62.

lines.text: I forgot about the kids. Then the fog horn sounded.
lines.say: (nervous) I forgot about the kids. Then the fog horn sounded.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Kai turns toward the sea. Fog rolls over the water. A horn sounds (sfx).

lines.text: My mum was on the night ferry. And the lighthouse was dark.
lines.say: (worried)(soft tone) My mum was on the night ferry. And the lighthouse was dark.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Wide: ferry lights blur in the fog at sea; the lighthouse on the hill is dark.

lines.text: She always waved at the lamp from the deck. Tonight, there was nothing to wave at.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) She always waved at the lamp from the deck. Tonight, there was nothing to wave at.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Memory flash (warm tint): Mum on a ferry deck waving up at a bright lighthouse. Back to the dark tower.

lines.text: At the foot of the hill stood Keeper Marlo. Frozen. Zero steps.
lines.say: (sad) At the foot of the hill stood Keeper Marlo. Frozen. Zero steps.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Old keeper frozen mid-step on the path, pale blue, a glowing 0, the big lamp key held out in his hand.

lines.text: Kai! Take my key. Someone has to light the lamp!
lines.say: (worried)(in a hurry tone) Kai! Take my key. Someone has to light the lamp!
lines.speaker: Marlo
lines.shot: Marlo's eyes and mouth move inside the frozen body. Kai takes the key from his hand.

lines.text: I only have sixty-two steps. The path is one hundred!
lines.say: (scared) I only have sixty-two steps. The path is one hundred!
lines.speaker: Kai
lines.shot: Kai looks from his 62 up the winding path; the top is lost in fog.

lines.text: Then don't waste a single one.
lines.say: (calm)(soft tone) Then don't waste (break) a single one.
lines.speaker: Marlo
lines.shot: Close on frozen Marlo; a small proud smile.

lines.text: So I climbed. And I counted.
lines.say: (confident) So I climbed. And I counted.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Kai starts up the dirt path, key in hand.

lines.text: Fifty. Forty. Thirty. Twenty...
lines.say: (nervous) Fifty. Forty. Thirty. Twenty...
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: The chest counter drops 50, 40, 30, 20 as the path winds; fog thickens; a cut on 20 to the next bend where it reads 12.

lines.text: Then the fog swallowed the path. Three steps the wrong way.
lines.say: (scared) Then the fog swallowed the path. Three steps the wrong way.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: At 12, Kai steps off the path into grey fog; his number drops 12, 11, 10, 9 as he stumbles back. Blue-grey fog, his yellow raincoat bright, a warm lamp glow far above.

lines.text: Wasted. Nine left. And I was only halfway up.
lines.say: (sad) Wasted. Nine left. And I was only halfway up.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Kai at a bend; chest reads 9; the lighthouse still far above.

lines.text: There sat Mrs. Pell on her bench, like every night. She never walked anywhere.
lines.say: (calm) There sat Mrs. Pell on her bench, like every night. She never walked anywhere.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: An old woman on a bench by the path, wrapped in a shawl.

lines.text: She still had nine hundred steps.
lines.say: (curious) She still had nine hundred steps.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Close on her chest: a bright 900.

lines.text: Mrs. Pell, please! Take the key up! You have so many steps!
lines.say: (scared) Mrs. Pell, please! Take the key up! You have so many steps!
lines.speaker: Kai
lines.shot: Kai holds the key out to her and points up the hill.

lines.text: Up there? Alone, in the fog?
lines.say: (scared) Up there? Alone, in the fog?
lines.speaker: Pell
lines.shot: Mrs. Pell clutches her shawl and stares up into the fog.

lines.text: I froze on this hill once, when I was a girl. All night. Nobody came.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) I froze on this hill once, when I was a girl. All night. Nobody came.
lines.speaker: Pell
lines.shot: Memory flash (cold blue tint): a small girl frozen on the dark hill, a 0 on her chest, eyes moving, nobody around.

lines.text: No. I'm not going up there.
lines.say: (upset) No. I'm not going up there.
lines.speaker: Pell
lines.shot: She looks away from him.

lines.text: So I went on alone. Eight. Six. Four.
lines.say: (sad) So I went on alone. Eight. Six. Four.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Kai climbs alone; the counter drops 8, 6, 4.

lines.text: I stopped. Forty-five steps to the top. Four steps on my chest.
lines.say: (worried) I stopped. (break) Forty-five steps to the top. Four steps on my chest.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Kai stands still; 4 on his chest; a small sign by the path reads 45 TO THE TOP.

lines.text: And out in the fog, the horn sounded again. Closer to the rocks.
lines.say: (scared)(soft tone) And out in the fog, the horn sounded again. Closer to the rocks.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Ferry lights drift toward dark rocks below the hill. Horn (sfx).

lines.text: I could go back down. Or freeze up here, in the dark.
lines.say: (worried) I could go back down. Or freeze up here, in the dark.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Kai looks down the path, then up into the fog, then down at Mrs. Pell.

lines.text: Mrs. Pell! You won't be alone this time.
lines.say: (empathetic) Mrs. Pell! You won't be alone this time.
lines.speaker: Kai
lines.shot: Kai cups his hands and calls down the hill to Mrs. Pell.

lines.text: Even if I freeze, I'll stay right next to you.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) Even if I freeze, (break) I'll stay right next to you.
lines.speaker: Kai
lines.shot: Kai holds out his free hand toward her, the 4 glowing on his chest.

lines.text: Please. Tonight, your steps could bring my mum home.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) Please. Tonight, your steps could bring my mum home.
lines.speaker: Kai
lines.shot: Kai's voice breaks. Below, Mrs. Pell looks out at the ferry lights.

lines.text: For a long moment, she didn't move.
lines.say: (worried) For a long moment, she didn't move.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Hold on Mrs. Pell on her bench, fog drifting.

lines.text: Then she stood up, climbed to me, and took my hand.
lines.say: (moved) Then she stood up, climbed to me, and took my hand.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Mrs. Pell climbs to Kai (900 ticks to 895) and takes his hand.

lines.text: Then we go together. Hold on tight.
lines.say: (empathetic)(soft tone) Then we go together. Hold on tight.
lines.speaker: Pell
lines.shot: Close on their joined hands; she smiles bravely. She has no idea what will happen to his number.

lines.text: My four didn't move. Only hers went down. She looked as surprised as me.
lines.say: (surprised) My four didn't move. Only hers went down. She looked as surprised as me.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: They climb together: his 4 stays still, hers ticks 895, 894, 893.

lines.text: That's what the two kids knew. Together, you walk on one number.
lines.say: (moved) That's what the two kids knew. Together, you walk on one number.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Quick echo of the two kids holding hands, then Kai and Mrs. Pell climbing into the fog.

lines.text: At the top, I turned the key. The lamp cut through the fog.
lines.say: (happy) At the top, I turned the key. The lamp cut through the fog.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: The lamp blazes; a beam sweeps over the sea.

lines.text: And the ferry turned toward the harbour.
lines.say: (relaxed) And the ferry turned toward the harbour.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Ferry lights turn away from the rocks toward the harbour. A soft horn.

lines.text: Eight hundred and fifty steps left. I've never felt so rich.
lines.say: (happy)(soft tone) Eight hundred and fifty steps left. I've never felt so rich.
lines.speaker: Pell
lines.shot: Mrs. Pell laughs softly, still holding Kai's hand at the top; her chest reads 850.

lines.text: Steps you keep for yourself disappear at sunrise.
lines.say: (moved)(soft tone) Steps you keep for yourself disappear at sunrise.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Wide: the two of them at the lamp; the beam sweeps; far below, frozen Marlo smiles.

lines.text: Steps you walk together can bring someone home.
lines.say: (moved)(soft tone) Steps you walk together can bring someone home.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Final image: the lit lighthouse over the fog, the ferry coming into the harbour.
